The student shall apply for a gate pass. He/She will visit the relevant office, & the authorized
representative at the designated place shall verify it with his/her parent/guardian and
approve or reject the gate pass.
Are Outsiders Allowed To Stay At Hostel?
Outsiders are not allowed to stay or enter the hostel premises. However, parents or legal
guardians of the concerned student may visit the hostel during the designated visiting
hours. TO ensure the privacy & comfort of all residents, parents/guardians are not permitted to
enter or visit students' rooms.

VI – SEMESTER RULES 
1. Dates/week of sessional exams and the final exam are 
announced at the commencement of the semester. 
Students are not allowed to miss any of the sessional 
and/or the final exams. No credit for the missed exams 
would be given to the student. 
2. Students are allowed to apply online for the retake of any 
missed exam due to hospitalization, accident, or family 
emergencies such as the death or marriage of a blood 
relative. They must provide valid proof for any of these 
reasons. Please note that a mere medical certificate will 
not be accepted for this facility. 
3. Students are strongly advised to avoid scheduling any 
personal events during the examination period. However, 
in case of a clash with an event, the co mmittee may 
review the request based on submitted evidence and 
decide accordingly. 
4. Please note that clashes due to Umrah or Itikaf will not be 
considered, as these are not mandatory requirements. 
5. In all cases, the Director is the final authority who would,  
after consultation with the concerned faculty member (s), 
give a decision within one week from the date of 
submission of the application. 
6. Students are allowed to Add/Drop a course during the 
first two weeks of the commencement of the semester. 
However, students admitted in First semester shall not be 
allowed to Add/Drop a course. Students are advised to 
attend all the classes of courses they intend to take 
during the semester. No add/drop requests will be 
entertained after the last date.

III - DISCIPLINARY CONDUCT 
Discipline 
Students are expected to observe disciplinary standards of the 
University in all their dealings. Failure to meet these standards will 
require them to appear before a Department Disciplinary 
Committee (DDC)/Campus Disciplinary Committee ( CDC), who 
may recommend a suitable action against the student. 
The action may amount to warning, suspension of studies for one 
or more semesters, expulsion from the University or 
disqualification from any academic honour such as award of 
gold medal, financial aid, scholarship, etc. 
Any of the following will call for a disciplinary action: 
1. Violation of the rules and regulations of the University. 
2. Wilful defiance of University's authority whether alone or 
in association with others. 
3. Involvement in activities that are against the interests 
and reputation of the University. 
4. Use of unfair means or breach of norms. 
5. Use of unfair means during the exam or any evaluation 
process used for academic purposes. 
6. Improper behaviour in or outside the classroom. 
7. Any act of dishonesty including submission of false 
documents and deliberate misreporting. 
8. Association with actions harmful to good teaching 
environment. 
9. Failure to meet the code of conduct as laid down by the 
University.
